description: Build and quality gates for pain001.com, the website of the Pain001 ISO 20022 payment initiation suite.
//type: Deliberately no "type" field: forcing ESM would make Node parse the vendored CommonJS static/pyodide/pyodide.asm.js as a module (ERR_AMBIGUOUS_MODULE_SYNTAX). This repo's own ESM files use .mjs, so Node's automatic syntax detection resolves each .js file correctly. Node warns (MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON) each time it re-parses such a file as ESM; the test commands silence exactly that warning.
